en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Umar Bin Azina, from Fuzayl Bin Yasaar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The dower is whatever both are agreed upon, from little or more, so this is the dower’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from ‘Umar ibn ‘Udhaynah from Fudayl ibn Yasar who has said the following: “Abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
The amount of mahr (dower) is what people agree upon which can be little or a great deal, that is mahr (dower).”’
